title: List the element and bond type included in the molecule with molecule ID of
question: List the element and bond type included in the molecule with molecule ID of TR002.

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1.element, T2.bond_type
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN MoleculeInfo AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
JOIN BondInfo AS T2 ON T3.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR002'
